GenAiFunction.description: Use this when a law-firm website visitor wants a free case review / case evaluation, or asks the firm to look at their situation — for example "can you review my case", "I want a free consultation about my accident", or "get help with my matter". Shows a guided intake form (a few quick questions, a description box, and contact fields) with a clear note that submitting does not create an attorney-client relationship, then hands the intake to the firm.
